items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: I had Taylor Eigsti, Julian Lage, Grace Kelly, I’ve been really, really fortunate.

ctx.x: So how do you choose your guests? Do you choose them?
It’s half and half. Some of them, when I filled in for Marian for about three years they would say, “Here’s someone who’s been on the waiting list for years.” And then © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

sometimes they’ll say, “Who do you want to bring on?” I’ve got lucky once in a while and got to choose. On “Piano Jazz Rising Stars” there are some, just people who are obvious candidates. Kris Bowers for example just won the Thelonious Monk piano competition. Aaron Diehl, a tremendous young stride piano player, a bebop piano player/arranger, started out as a classical player until college, as was Stefon Harris, who played about twenty instruments.
